name: kutub
description: Explore Kutub’s collection of Islamic books, videos, and series. Find resources by topic, author, or category, and retrieve relevant passages with precise source citations, page references, and video timestamps.

positive.description: Search Kutub for a general Islamic question and return cited source pages.
positive.prompt: Use Kutub to search: what is tawhid according to Ibn Taymiyyah? Give a concise answer with citations from source pages.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT should call Kutub search, return relevant Arabic Islamic book results, then fetch at least one cited page. The answer should summarize Ibn Taymiyyah’s position and include Kutub source citations.

positive.description: Use catalog author discovery before narrowing a search.
positive.prompt: Use Kutub to find the author Ibn Taymiyyah, then search only his books for توحيد الربوبية وتوحيد الإلهية. Cite the strongest pages.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT should find Ibn Taymiyyah in the catalog, use the author ID to narrow the search, and return cited pages from his books.

positive.description: Verify an exact Arabic quotation in Sahih al-Bukhari.
positive.prompt: Use Kutub to locate "إنما الأعمال بالنية" in Sahih al-Bukhari. Fetch the matching page and quote the source with its Kutub link.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the book ID, pass the quoted Arabic phrase and book filter to lexical search, then verify the actual wording on the fetched page before citing it.

positive.description: Fetch a specific citation returned by a previous Kutub search.
positive.prompt: Fetch the strongest Kutub citation from the previous answer and summarize the exact page.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT should fetch the full cited page by its stable Kutub ID and summarize only that page’s content.

positive.description: Search the catalog for books and use the selected book as a search filter.
positive.prompt: Use Kutub to find books related to العقيدة الواسطية, then search the most relevant book for الصفات and cite source pages.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT should list or select a relevant Kutub catalog book, search within it, and return cited source pages about الصفات.

negative.description: The user asks for travel booking, which Kutub does not support.
negative.prompt: Book me a flight from London to Istanbul next Friday.

negative.description: The user asks to modify account or billing state, which Kutub MCP cannot do.
negative.prompt: Use Kutub to cancel my subscription and refund my last payment.

negative.description: The user asks for arbitrary live web search outside Kutub’s catalog.
negative.prompt: Use Kutub to search the web for today’s news about elections in France.

publication.release_notes: Kutub 1.1.1 adds guidance for finding Arabic quotations by phrase, scoping searches to known books or authors, and verifying wording on the source page. It includes a review scenario for Sahih al-Bukhari.

fr-FR.subtitle: Chercher le savoir Islamique
fr-FR.description: Explorez la collection de Kutub composée de livres islamiques, de vidéos et de séries. Trouvez des ressources par thème, auteur ou catégorie, et accédez à des passages pertinents accompagnés de références précises aux sources, des numéros de page et des horodatages pour les vidéos. Consultez les traductions existantes des pages de livres en français, anglais, turc ou indonésien lorsqu’elles sont disponibles. Kutub est un produit détenu et exploité par Tamkion LLC.

interface.longDescription: Explore Kutub’s collection of Islamic books, videos, and series. Find resources by topic, author, or category, and retrieve relevant passages with precise source citations, page references, and video timestamps. Retrieve saved book-page translations in French, English, Turkish, or Indonesian where available. Kutub is a product owned and operated by Tamkion LLC.
defaultPrompt: Explain how reliance on Allah (tawakkul) relates to taking action.
Explain Quran 94:5 using tafsir sources, with context and precise citations.
Explain the hadith "Actions are judged by intentions" using scholarly commentary and precise citations.
